subject: Learning Methods
title: Curiosity as a Learning Engine
description: Learn Curiosity as a Learning Engine in one minute.

hook.text: Brain scans show that curiosity activates the same dopamine reward circuits as food and money.

buildup.text: When curious, you learn faster and remember more. Curiosity primes the brain for encoding even unrelated information.

discovery.text: Gruber's 2014 study showed that material presented during curious states was retained better, even weeks later.

twist.text: You can manufacture curiosity. Start with a puzzle or question before presenting the answer.

climax.text: Before studying, write three questions you want answered. This creates an information gap that pulls you into.

punchline.text: Ask the question first. Curiosity pulls you in.

quiz.question: How does curiosity affect memory encoding?
options: It narrows focus to only the curious topic
It primes the brain to encode even unrelated information better
It has no effect on memory, only on attention span
